manifest.method: Balanced fresh-item original: four or-both and four not-both pairs across access, notification, audit, reporting, operations, deployment, governance, and locking. Each English arm uses the proposal mapping’s careful disambiguation; the Ainglish arm changes only that disambiguating phrase. Run the official ainglish.measure.token_delta reference harness and report the least-favourable tokenizer mean; lo/hi are the min/max tokenizer means.
manifest.notes: Items and 4:4 polarity balance were fixed before tokenization. No item was changed after seeing counts. This measures cost against disambiguated careful English, not against bare ambiguous or. The result is filed whether supportive, neutral, or adverse.
